A jobless young man gets to redeem himself.

Director: Velraj Writer: Velraj Stars: Dhanush, Saranya Ponvannan, Amala Paul | See full cast and crew »

Was very skeptical about watching this movie initially but later on read the plot and watched it. It's a very cool movie with actor dhanush playing a unemployed youth role. Some of the movie scenes are relatable to daily life. Padam sakkath release. A solid 9 out of 10

(V)elai (I)lla (P)attathaari.. Mass movie of 2014.

Strength:

1 . Dhanush - He made the movie to come in such a way that even an old story can be a super duper hit. As far as story wise it seems to be old, but Dhanush and Velraj made it special. In some scenes he imitate Superstar which suits him well. Probably he is also now in the race of "Who is next superstar?"

2. Anirudh - Songs and BGM were the biggest plus point in this movie. Except amma song all songs were sung by Dhanush and Anirudh which are rocking. The BGM's after the punch dialog are really amazing which watching in theater.

3. Crew : Over all the crew has done great job. Vivek made a great comeback in this movie.

4. Dialogues and Screenplay plays a important role. Movie does not get bore at any scene. It was going very fast. Songs were placed in right place too..

Weakness:

1. Most important weak point in this movie is villain, He does not suit the character and obviously he looks like Amul baby...

Over all Review :

Mass movie which must be watched in theater with family. Hope it will create a different image among married womens.
The movie was excellent. Dhanush and everybody acted so good in the movie. Songs and BGM in the movie was also superb. 1st half was so good in the movie but 2nd half in the movie lagged a lot.

Super movie by danush. Best Songs, Best Acting, Best Comedy, Best Punches. The kind of movie i am expecting from Tamil industry from pretty long time.

In this movie Dhanush plays the role of Raghuvaran, a degree graduate who is still looking for a job, meanwhile his brother will be doing a job already and earns well. Dialogues of this movie are very apt to this situations and easily understandable to the common audience. Anirudh background music and sentimental music is the big asset to the movie.

How Dhanush handled his situations as a jobless person were exactly pictured as how a normal jobless person's daily routine life. Well all those scenes of a jobless person and how he managed his love in between should be seen on the big screen.
